display.purpose: Section headlines and hero H1. Always uppercase, always font-black. The compressed leading (0.9) makes type read as a visual block.

body.purpose: Section paragraphs. Max line length 65ch. Color varies by scene: gray-300 on dark, gray-800 on concrete.

label.purpose: Section eyebrow labels above headlines. Always uppercase, always muted. Color is scene-tinted, not globally consistent.

shadows.name: card-concrete
shadows.purpose: Card ambient shadow on Thermal Concrete scenes (Story, WhatsApp sections).

shadows.name: card-dark
shadows.purpose: Card ambient shadow on dark scenes (Boss, Jet sections). Heavier opacity to maintain contrast.

shadows.name: glass-hover-glow
shadows.purpose: Active hover state for all .glass-hover elements. The component glows from within.

shadows.name: glass-inset-resting
shadows.purpose: Passive resting state of .liquid-glass surfaces. Faint top-edge shimmer.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions — glass-hover lift, button color changes, nav link opacity.

motion.name: duration-glass-hover
motion.purpose: Duration for .glass-hover state transitions (background, shadow, transform).

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Duration for button color, nav link opacity, and other quick UI feedback.

motion.name: duration-entrance
motion.purpose: FadeIn entrance animations on section load. Staggered in 100–200ms increments per element.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-contrast CTA. Cloud white against jet or glass backgrounds. Used for primary conversion actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #F8F9FA; color: #0A0B0E; padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); font-family: inherit; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E8E9EA; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #F8F9FA; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost / Glass Button
components.description: Secondary CTA on dark backgrounds. Liquid glass surface, white border, responds with glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.01); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); color: #F8F9FA; padding: 10px 24px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 400ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); font-family: inherit; } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255,255,255,0.15), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.5); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navbar
components.description: Fixed glass navbar floating over hero video. Pill shape, cloud-white CTA in top-right corner.

components.css: .ds-navbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.01); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-navbar-logo { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #F8F9FA; cursor: pointer; transition: color 300ms; font-family: inherit; } .ds-navbar-logo:hover { color: rgba(248,249,250,0.8); } .ds-navbar-links { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-navbar-link { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: color 200ms; } .ds-navbar-link:hover { color: #F8F9FA; } .ds-navbar-cta { background: #F8F9FA; color: #0A0B0E; padding: 8px 24px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.1em; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms; font-family: inherit; } .ds-navbar-cta:hover { background: #E8E9EA; }

components.name: Liquid Glass Card
components.description: Signature surface component. Contains feature content across all sections. Background opacity and shadow adjust to match scene darkness.
components.html:
Clasificación Inteligente

Analiza el contexto de cada correo para priorizar y delegar sin intervención manual.
components.css: .ds-glass-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1), 0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.3); padding: 32px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: all 400ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); cursor: pointer; } .ds-glass-card::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; padding: 1.4px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 20%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0) 60%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 80%, rgba(255,255,255,0.45) 100%); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#fff 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#fff 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; pointer-events: none; } .ds-glass-card:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(255,255,255,0.15), inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); transform: translateY(-4px); } .ds-glass-card-title { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 500; color: #F8F9FA; margin: 0 0 16px 0; font-family: inherit; } .ds-glass-card-body { font-size: 0.875rem; color: rgba(209,213,219,1); line-height: 1.625; margin: 0; font-family: inherit; }

components.name: Section Overline Label
components.description: Text label above each section headline. Always uppercase, always muted. Color varies by scene.
components.css: .ds-overline { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); margin-bottom: 16px; font-family: inherit; }

components.name: Tagline Pill
components.description: Ambient label pill. Hero corner element for brand statements. No interaction, no fill — pure glass.
components.css: .ds-tagline-pill { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.01); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 24px; display: inline-block; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.1); } .ds-tagline-text { font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 300; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.2em; color: rgba(248,249,250,0.7); margin: 0; font-family: inherit; }

narrative.overview:
The AI works while the client sleeps. This design system is built around that promise: premium darkness as the product's ambient state, and light as a signal — not decoration. The base canvas is near-black jet. Every section that follows introduces its own environment: thermal concrete for the workhorse email agents, warm sepia for social commerce, a cold command slate for the orchestrating intelligence. The visitor scrolls through scenes, not a scroll.

Typography dominates. Display type is compressed to 0.9 line-height, uppercased, tracked tight — it fills the frame like a title card. There is no clutter around it. The agents in the videos are the product; the design creates the stage they perform on.

Glass surfaces (.liquid-glass) serve as interface architecture: they float over scene backgrounds without rupturing them. They are the technology made visible — transparent, reflective, containing depth. They glow when touched. They never decorate.
keyCharacteristics: Dark is the default; light enters only as scene-specific context or direct CTA signal
Every scroll section changes color environment — each is a distinct, named scene
Typography-first hierarchy: scale and weight do the work, not color or decoration
Liquid glass is structural, never cosmetic
The AI avatar videos are primary content; the UI frames and amplifies them, never competes

rules.name: The Scene Change Rule
rules.body: Each section owns its color environment. Thermal concrete, warm sepia, and command slate are scene-specific backgrounds — never mix them. The hero and closing sections return to jet.

rules.name: The Channel Color Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green and Instagram magenta are channel signals, not brand colors. They appear only inside their own sections, at low opacity tints (10–35%). A green button outside the WhatsApp section is forbidden.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: Display type is exclusively font-black (900). Everything else is 400–700. The jump from body to display is violent on purpose — that contrast IS the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Uppercase Compression Rule
rules.body: Display type is always uppercased and tracking-tighter. This makes the type block read as a single graphic unit at hero scale. Body copy is never uppercased.

rules.name: The Stage Lighting Rule
rules.body: Shadows serve scene logic, not element hierarchy. A card in a dark scene gets a heavier drop shadow than the same card in a light scene — not because it's more important, but because the stage demands it.

rules.name: The Glass Hover Invariant
rules.body: Every .glass-hover element responds to pointer interaction with the white glow pulse plus a −4px translateY lift. A glass surface that doesn't respond to touch breaks the luminous and contained promise.

dos: Do use uppercase and tracking-tighter for all display headlines (0.9 line-height, −0.05em tracking).
Do change the color environment between sections. Each section earns its own background.
Do apply .glass-hover (glow + translateY(−4px)) to every interactive glass surface.
Do respect the scene when choosing card fill opacity: bg-white/20 on light concrete scenes, bg-white/5 on dark scenes.
Do keep WhatsApp green (#25D366) and Instagram magenta (#E1306C) contained to their own sections.
Do use max-w-lg or max-w-xl on body paragraphs to enforce the 65ch line-length limit.
Do let the AI agent videos be primary content. Design frames them; never overlap or compete.
Do use linear gradient masks on video containers so agents fade into the scene.
donts: Don't use chatbot-bubble iconography — floating green chat bubbles, WhatsApp-green everywhere, call-center aesthetic.
Don't use corporate stock imagery, handshake photos, or flat blue-gray palettes.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text). Single solid color for all text.
Don't use decorative glassmorphism — glass surfaces must contain content or define structure.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as an accent).
Don't use bounce or elastic easing. All motion uses ease-out curves.
Don't apply the same background to consecutive sections.
Don't use WhatsApp green or Instagram magenta as global brand accent colors.
Don't use pure #000000 or #FFFFFF — use Jet (#0A0B0E) and Cloud White (#F8F9FA).
Don't use identical card grids — same size, icon, heading, text repeated without variation.
